analysis.interpretation: Cross-cell per-variant effects, fixed 2026-10-28 before any variant result: same windows, mask 4, 10 labeling strata, proxy thresholds 0.01/0.60 and primary family as the 21 Oct mask-4 HepG2 run. Footprint scalars (msp, nuc_85_250, tf_small) now come from plasmid-LLR (min_llr 5, drawdown 25, each cell's own fold-A table) in both cells.

footprints.interpretation: Fixed 2026-10-28 before any footprint-effect result. Plasmid-LLR coverage (min_llr 5, drawdown 25). Windows exclude +-4 bp (mask_radius) where the observability kernel is strongest; net = C_std - M removes the remaining change also seen on near-naked molecules. TF = calls 10-60 bp; nuc = calls 85-250 bp.

functional.effect: mean of the two published log2 values (r = 0.97 between sources; not independent)
functional.hit: BH q < 0.05 in both sources with the same sign

rules.activator_footprint: TF footprint loss (tf:fp_local:net < 0, q<0.05) and activity down
rules.repressor_footprint: TF footprint loss and activity up
rules.created_repressor_footprint: TF footprint gain and activity down
rules.created_activator_footprint: TF footprint gain and activity up
rules.activator_accessibility: accessibility down (msp_C_std < 0, q<0.05) and activity down
rules.discordant_accessibility: accessibility and activity change in opposite directions

classification.precedence: footprint label first; accessibility label if no significant footprint change
